text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Lady Rose.
Are you returning to the academy already?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I was able to see my younger sisters
as well.
I was truly astonished by how much the two
of them have grown.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
By the time those two have grown,
I would love to show them our Rose Clan
standing upon an unshakable foundation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must devote myself even further so that
I may achieve it through my running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After her time off,
Rose Kingdom strode briskly
into the trainer's office.
It seemed she had enjoyed a wonderful
break.
